title: 第1448章 来自大能的接引第1447章 胖毛的化形
lines: 李卓阳的体内空间收取其他人或者妖兽时，一般都是需要对方的配合的，否则那股抗拒之意，他单凭空间法力，是很难控制的。
当然了，法力修为远远小于他的，则不在此列。
“胖毛，不要抗拒，赶紧回到空间。”李卓阳连忙吩咐道。
“不是，老大，我没有抗拒啊……”
胖毛双眼无辜地道。
李卓阳闻言，这才再度朝空中看去。
这时，他才感受到，那眼眸之中，似乎有一股若有若无的空间之力，将胖毛给锁定了起来。
这股空间之力，并非寻常的空间法力，而是蕴含着一丝自成天地的独立空间法则，故而即便其看似微弱，但是李卓阳的空间法力，却拿他没办法。
当然，这也意味着，这只眼眸的背后，至少是一位合体境的大能，在操控着。
被一位合体境的大能盯上，肯定不是一件好事儿！
李卓阳感受到此，身上气息，瞬间暴涨而起！
与此同时，剑丸也在这一刻化为了一道百丈剑芒，朝着那眼眸下方无形的空间之力斩去。
这一剑，气势极为惊人，就连天空似乎都被一剑斩为两半。
然而，那些空间之力，毕竟蕴含着自成天地的空间法则，在这一剑之下，竟然不受分毫影响。
见到此幕，李卓阳已然知晓，寻常的炼虚境的手段，对其已经没有丝毫作用了。
于是，下一瞬，李卓阳暴喝一声。
而后，其身上金光一闪，身躯陡然间便暴涨一倍有余，粗大的四肢和胸腹，肉眼可见地膨起了坚实无比的肌肉。
神魔战体！
这次施展的神魔战体，与之前应对海神法相时，还不太一样，因为他将从佛子那里得来的佛光之力，也加持了上来，身躯在布满紫黑魔纹的同时，又现出了无数卍字符！
“给我破！”
怒吼声中，李卓阳伸出耀眼得令人无法直视地手指，一指戳向了那个眼眸。
神魔战体加四合指！
这一击，可谓是李卓阳眼下的巅峰实力。
毕竟，其单纯的肉身之力，就已经是炼虚境大圆满的级别，施展神魔战体后，实力足以媲美普通的合体境初期修士。
再加上四合指这将肉身之力运用到极致的绝招，可以说，即便是真正的合体境初期巅峰强者，或许都不敢小觑。
果然，当四合指之力戳向眼眸之际，那眼眸之中，便出现了一个黑洞。
“呼……终于破了吗？”
李卓阳感觉到那道空间法则之力为之一顿时，心中终于松了一口气。
然而，未等他跟胖毛说句什么，却见那黑洞瞬间便扩大了十多倍，而后一道更为强大的空间法则之力，以迅雷不及掩耳之势，直接笼罩到了胖毛身上。
随后，胖毛庞大的身躯，便在挣扎之中，被这道空间之力束缚着缓缓升起。
“老大，救我！”
胖毛在这道法力中，只觉得一阵无能为力，只好朝李卓阳呼喊道。
“胖毛！”
李卓阳此刻，也同样心急。
content_en:
When Li Zhuoyang's internal space captures other people or monsters, he usually needs the cooperation of the other party. Otherwise, it will be difficult for him to control the resistance with his space magic power alone.
Of course, those whose magic power is far smaller than his are not included in this list.
"Fat Mao, don't resist, return to space quickly." Li Zhuoyang quickly ordered.
"No, boss, I didn't resist..."
Fatty's eyes were innocent.
After hearing this, Li Zhuoyang looked into the sky again.
Only then did he feel that there seemed to be a vague power of space in those eyes, locking Fatty Mao.
This space power is not ordinary space mana, but contains a trace of independent space law that forms a world of its own. Therefore, even though it seems weak, Li Zhuoyang's space mana cannot do anything to him.
Of course, this also means that behind this eye, there is at least a powerful person in the Fusion Realm controlling it.
It is definitely not a good thing to be targeted by a powerful person in the Fusion Realm!
Li Zhuoyang felt this, and the aura on his body suddenly surged!
At the same time, Jianwan also turned into a hundred-foot sword light at this moment, slashing towards the invisible power of space under the eyes.
The momentum of this sword was so amazing that even the sky seemed to be cut in half by the sword.
However, the power of those spaces, after all, contains the laws of space that form the world, and are not affected at all by this sword.
Seeing this scene, Li Zhuoyang already knew that ordinary Void Refining Realm methods had no effect on him.
So, the next moment, Li Zhuoyang shouted loudly.
Then, a golden light flashed from his body, and his body suddenly more than doubled in size. His thick limbs, chest and abdomen were visibly swollen with extremely solid muscles.
God and Demon Battle Body!
The God-Demon War Body he used this time was different from the one he used to deal with the Poseidon Dharma Appearance before, because he was also blessed with the power of Buddha's light he received from the Buddha. While his body was covered with purple and black demon patterns, countless swastikas appeared!
"Break it for me!"
Amidst the roar, Li Zhuoyang stretched out his finger that was so dazzling that it was impossible to look directly at him, and poked that eye with one finger.
The battle body of gods and demons plus four folded fingers!
This attack can be said to be the peak of Li Zhuoyang's current strength.
After all, his pure physical strength is already at the Great Perfection level of the Void Refining Realm. After using the God-Demon Battle Body, his strength is comparable to that of an ordinary early-stage Fusion Realm monk.
Coupled with the unique trick of the Four Fingers, which utilizes the power of the physical body to the extreme, it can be said that even the true peak powerhouses in the early stages of the Fusion Realm may not dare to underestimate him.
Sure enough, when he poked his eyes with the force of his four fingers, a black hole appeared in those eyes.
"Huh...is it finally broken?"
When Li Zhuoyang felt the power of the space law, he finally breathed a sigh of relief.
However, before he could say anything to Fat Mao, he saw that the black hole expanded more than ten times in an instant, and then a more powerful force of space law directly enveloped Fat Mao with lightning speed.
Then, Fatty's huge body was struggling and slowly rose up while being restrained by the power of space.
"Boss, save me!"
Fatty Mao felt helpless under this magical power, so he had no choice but to shout to Li Zhuoyang.
"Fat Hair!"
Li Zhuoyang was equally anxious at this moment.
title_en: Chapter 1448: Guidance from the Great Power Chapter 1447: Fatty’s Transformation
